ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sideline Social uses your location when you choose Find Nearby to discover sports communities near your current venue. Your precise location is not shown to other users.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sideline Social uses your microphone only when you choose to record a voice message in a chat or team conversation.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Sideline Social may use motion activity to support location features when you choose Find Nearby. Motion data is not displayed to other users.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Sideline Social saves a photo to your photo library only when you choose Save Photo.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sideline Social lets you choose a photo when you send an image message in a private friend chat. Photo metadata is stripped before upload.
